benefits.title: Expected Benefits Impact & Measurable Outcomes
benefits.subtitle: Direct mapping between academic project goals (B1–B6) and live platform telemetry
benefits.b1_claim: Platform is used as the primary, central community hub.
benefits.b1_desc: Proves community members converge in one unified feed rather than fragmented third-party channels.
benefits.b2_claim: People quickly discover content through search and tags.
benefits.b2_desc: Proves taxonomy and search engine effectively connect users to targeted information.
benefits.b3_claim: Community interaction and engagement are actively growing.
benefits.b3_desc: Proves two-way social dialogue is vibrant and network effects are strengthening.
benefits.b4_claim: Moderation workflow is fast, auditable, and maintains safety.
benefits.b4_desc: Proves community standards are systematically enforced with low latency.
benefits.b5_claim: Data directly informs when and what content to broadcast.
benefits.b5_desc: Proves creators and editors have clear quantitative guidance on community appetite.
benefits.b6_claim: Role enforcement, audit logs, and account governance protect integrity.
benefits.b6_desc: Proves the multi-role security architecture reliably prevents unauthorized access.
benefits.heatmap_subtitle: Engagement volume aggregated by day of week and hour of day (UTC+7)
